svg.aria-label: A go/no-go inspection bench for a tool call. A model box at the back left issues a card printed with the tool's arguments. The card rides a lane under a schema gauge marked CalculateArgs: expression must exist and be a string. A valid card goes on to a calculator, which runs. An invalid card is turned by a gate onto a return loop, passes an error clip that pins the validation error to it, and goes back into the model for another attempt. Lamps on the model count attempts, up to max_retries plus one. After the last failed attempt, the clip pins an error tag instead and the card returns as data, so the request stays alive.

g.text: # must exist, must be a string
